capabilities: Render :::mermaid blocks through Obsidian's mermaid pipeline
Show [[_TOC_]] and [[_TOSP_]] macros as labelled chips
Render headings written without a space after the hashes
Decode Azure-encoded page filenames across the interface
Diagnose why a :::mermaid diagram did not render
disambiguation: Does not connect to Azure DevOps or publish anything; it only renders files in a locally cloned wiki vault.
extras: The heading and page-name decoding settings should stay off unless the vault is an Azure Wiki clone; in ordinary vaults they would turn tags like #todo into headings or read every hyphen as a space. Known limitation: spaceless headings remain indexed as tags in search, tag pane, and graph.
motivation: The author built it because the dialect differences are silent: pages look fine locally and break once published, and the plugin renders Azure's dialect without changing the source.
problem: Azure DevOps Wiki markdown differs silently from Obsidian's, so a cloned wiki page can look fine locally but break once published, or vice versa.
summary: Renders Azure DevOps Wiki markdown dialects in Obsidian: :::mermaid blocks, TOC macros, spaceless headings, and encoded page names.
